scope: messaging projection + starter social, with recorded diagnostic mutations; no full-social-scale claim
inspection: read-only SQLite; no explicit checkpoint, vacuum or compaction

schema.name: _asset_views
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _asset_views (
                asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                principal TEXT NOT NULL,
                at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, principal)
             )

schema.name: _assets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _assets (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('receiving', 'ready', 'failed')),
                kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('image', 'video')),
                type TEXT,
                bytes INTEGER CHECK(bytes IS NULL OR bytes >= 0),
                width INTEGER CHECK(width IS NULL OR width > 0),
                height INTEGER CHECK(height IS NULL OR height > 0),
                duration INTEGER CHECK(duration IS NULL OR duration > 0),
                created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                released_at INTEGER,
                staged_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(staged_bytes >= 0),
                reclaiming INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reclaiming IN (0, 1)),
                locator_table TEXT,
                locator_row TEXT,
                locator_column TEXT,
                CHECK(
                    (locator_table IS NULL AND locator_row IS NULL AND locator_column IS NULL) OR
                    (locator_table IS NOT NULL AND locator_row IS NOT NULL AND locator_column IS NOT NULL)
                )
             )

schema.name: _client_intents
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _client_intents (
                principal TEXT NOT NULL,
                intent TEXT NOT NULL,
                request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
                response TEXT NOT NULL,
                seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
                at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (principal, intent)
             )

schema.name: _client_intents_at
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX _client_intents_at ON _client_intents(at)

schema.name: _commits
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _commits (
                seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                program TEXT NOT NULL,
                principal TEXT NOT NULL,
                kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                by TEXT,
                touched TEXT NOT NULL,
                writes TEXT NOT NULL,
                emits INTEGER NOT NULL
             , scope_touches TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', job TEXT, job_chunk TEXT, schedule TEXT)

schema.name: _credentials
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _credentials (
                principal TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                hash TEXT NOT NULL
             )

schema.name: _grant_slices
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _grant_slices (
                grant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                principal TEXT NOT NULL,
                intent TEXT NOT NULL,
                offset INTEGER NOT NULL,
                count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(count > 0),
                PRIMARY KEY (grant_id, intent)
             )

schema.name: _grant_slices_extent
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX _grant_slices_extent
                ON _grant_slices(grant_id, offset, count)

schema.name: _grants
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _grants (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                principal TEXT NOT NULL,
                [from] TEXT NOT NULL,
                count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(count > 0),
                minted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
             )

schema.name: _grants_principal_expiry
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX _grants_principal_expiry
                ON _grants(principal, expires_at)

schema.name: _jobs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _jobs (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT, program_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        generation TEXT NOT NULL, args TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL,
        sweep INTEGER NOT NULL, upper_key TEXT, cursor TEXT, chunks INTEGER NOT NULL,
        rows_written TEXT NOT NULL, enqueued_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, finished_at INTEGER, last_error TEXT)

schema.name: _jobs_state_created
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX _jobs_state_created ON _jobs(state, created_at)

schema.name: _meta
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _meta (
                key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                value TEXT NOT NULL
             )

schema.name: _operation_intents
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _operation_intents (
                principal TEXT NOT NULL,
                intent TEXT NOT NULL,
                request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
                response TEXT NOT NULL,
                seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
                at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (principal, intent)
             )

schema.name: _outbox
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _outbox (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
                effect TEXT NOT NULL,

                state TEXT NOT NULL,
                attempts INTEGER NOT NULL,
                next_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                last_error TEXT,

                then_op TEXT,

schema.name: _outbox_state_next_at

schema.name: _principals
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _principals (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

                name TEXT,
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
             )

schema.name: _search_nodes
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _search_nodes (
        node INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, table_name TEXT NOT NULL, index_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        parent INTEGER NOT NULL, scalar INTEGER NOT NULL, refs INTEGER NOT NULL, depth INTEGER NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(table_name,index_name,parent,scalar))

schema.name: _search_postings
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _search_postings (
        table_name TEXT NOT NULL, index_name TEXT NOT NULL, row_id TEXT NOT NULL, node INTEGER NOT NULL,
        c0 TEXT,c1 TEXT,c2 TEXT,c3 TEXT,c4 TEXT,c5 TEXT,c6 TEXT,c7 TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY(table_name,index_name,row_id,node)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: _search_postings_by_row
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX _search_postings_by_row ON _search_postings(table_name,row_id,index_name,node)

schema.name: _search_postings_lookup
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX _search_postings_lookup ON _search_postings(
        table_name,index_name,c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5,c6,c7,row_id,node)

schema.name: _sessions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _sessions (
                auth_epoch INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                token_digest BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE
                    CHECK(typeof(token_digest) = 'blob' AND length(token_digest) = 32),
                principal TEXT NOT NULL,
                kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
             )

schema.name: _timers

CREATE TABLE _timers (
